pages.text:
Keeps the chunks round it loaded so machines keep running while you're away. The globe turns while it works.
- Radius 0 loads its own chunk; 1 a 3x3, 2 a 5x5. Set it with − and +.
- The GUI maps the chunks, and outlines them in the world while it's open.
- It loads chunks for the player who placed it (security as usual). Each player may keep 25 chunks loaded in all.

# It stops
- When it's broken.
- When a redstone signal turns it off.
- When it would take you over your limit.
- If the server asks for it: while you're offline (it starts again when you log in), or when it runs out of FE when it needs FE per chunk.
Once its own chunk unloads it waits until the chunk is next loaded. Settings are in the chunkLoader config.
